policy: Each entry names a source this plugin took text or files from. The upstream-review skill fetches each, diffs its sourcePath since reviewedCommit, and proposes adopt, adapt or skip per change; a change is applied to our customised copy, never by replacing it. reviewedCommit moves only after the approved changes pass the checks.

upstreams.name: taste-skill
upstreams.reviewNotes: ui-dev is a customised fork of the v2 skill: scope widened to every surface, brand rules beat aesthetic defaults, marketing caps demoted to prompts, quotes and facts preserved, pre-flight reported honestly. The three style skills feed references/styles.md and the redesign skill feeds references/redesign.md.

upstreams.name: emilkowalski-skills
upstreams.reviewNotes: Vendored as copies with three local changes: descriptions edited so no two trigger on the same phrase and each names its lineage; em dashes replaced (scripts/strip-em-dashes.py re-applies this after a sync); pick-ui-library made model-invocable so animate's hand-off to it works; the opportunities skill's four-question gate lifted into improve-animations/AUDIT.md. Not vendored: emil-design-eng, find-animation-opportunities, animation-vocabulary, ask-sonner.

upstreams.name: impeccable
upstreams.reviewNotes: Text lifted, not files: the four modes and the craft floor into the body, the operate reference and the copy, empty-state, cognitive-load and triage passages into references/operate.md, the typography lines into references/read.md, the product and design file conventions into references/design-file.md. The detector binary is a pinned npm dependency (package.json), updated by npm, not by this review.

upstreams.name: stitch-skills
upstreams.reviewNotes: Four skills installed as companions in ~/.claude/skills (not vendored here); ui-dev routes to them by name. Text lifted into references/stitch.md: the generation rule (a design system present means no colour, font or theme in a generation prompt), the edit-prompt shape, the variant options, the id-shape table, the signed-URL and width-suffix rules, and the placeholder-link trap.
